estimand: Difference in mean support (1-7, 'don't know' already absent from the file) between each message and the control, divided by 6; m8-m10 against Democrats and Republicans in the control. Unweighted (rule fixed before reading the data).
data_notes: 13708 respondents, all flagged complete, consented, passing the attention check, not duplicate or fraud; none excluded. pol has three codes in the file; 1 = Democrat, 2 = Independent, 3 = Republican is inferred from the group sizes against the recruitment design (no codebook read).
